title: No unit number shows the asset instead, a real zero still shows
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Work orders: (a) unit present; (b) unit missing but asset present; (c) unit and asset both missing; (d) a field with a genuine value of zero.
custom_steps:
1. View the four work orders.
  2. Confirm (b) shows asset year/make/model where the unit would be;
  3. confirm (c) omits that content;
  4. confirm (d) shows the zero as a value, not as missing/blank.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If unit number is missing, the available asset year/make/model is shown in its place.
  • If both unit number and the fallback asset details are missing, that content is left out.
  • A genuine zero is shown as a value, not treated as missing.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10048 — Story 5 Choose what is shown. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S5-E1, S5-E5, S5-E4 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-E1: “If unit number is missing, use available asset year/make/model in its place.”
  • S5-E5: “If both unit number and fallback asset details are missing, omit that content.”
  • S5-E4: “Do not treat a valid zero as a missing value.”
